title: EERIE's Marvelous Masquerade
description: Delight your senses! A simple, candy-colored texture pack. Contains irradiated creepers. Masks not included.
body:
# EERIE'S MARVELOUS MASQUERADE ![rainbow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cd2456a9eb7d3b9511450b9811442936ca870dce.png)
A texturing endeavor as I explore the modmaking scene of Java. Essentially my first time making a resource pack, though i've made skins in the past. This also has two sister projects planned/in the works;
  • Retexturable elytra model resource pack (if possible. planned, not started)
  • Fresh Animations compatability pack (in progress, will update as this does)
The purpose of this pack is to add a decorative flair to minecraft, with more simplistic details and only few changes. This features loyalty to the resolution of vanilla, and tweaks of less-loved textures.

Upcoming:

    - May add dependency on something that allows for random entities

  • More mobs, start blocks before/after non-boss mobs
  • People from my private discord server vote on the next mob I retexture, so updates are random.
